items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: Mrs. Brown D'Lee was with me that night too and it was quite a shock for all of us. We walked in and we were over there

ctx.x: That was at the Dream Room and I was very much pleased, but I was surprised too. I mean that was for Sharky to do it or somebody like that. Sharky stopped the band one night and said, ladies and gentlemen, Mr. Jazz himself has just walked in. He said, Mr. Norman Brown D'Lee. Brown D'Lee. Brown D'Lee. He said, well you know Sharky was always carrying on the brown hat and everything, derby. But Mrs. Brown D'Lee was with me that night too and it was quite a shock for all of us. We walked in and we were over there…
Before we got in here, you mentioned Anton Lada too.
